scope: Offline review of frozen Pages Edge-preservation gate correction and Admin registered-module extraction only; this is not a push/deployment/hosted verification receipt.

checks.intakeWebPushConfigEvidenceBasis: Accepted complete source graphs and corresponding deno configuration, original deployment-version entrypoint paths, current full configuration pins; not a claim that complete pre-TenBot metadata exists for every function.

rootIntegrationRequirements: Source-proof producer must emit decodedBodySha256 and new registered-Admin extraction fields/method before use; old verify-edge-sources.mjs raw-substring producer is incompatible and must not be run unchanged.
Root must supply the actual stage-specific pinned proof and preserve the full current configuration fields; Production must pass strict exact comparison after its own authorized origin update.
Existing WebPush transport/Cron, privacy/logging, owner-auth, provider/free-plan and exact candidate gates remain independently required.
limits: Admin proof establishes canonical authored TypeScript in the unique registered entrypoint source map and records compiled bytes/hash; it does not claim the historical Oct12 compiled Admin bundle is current.
Secret-version increments are actual recorded deltas; official implementation does not promise a universal increment rule.
